claim: The tightened command guard (scripts/hooks/secret_path_guard.py, sha256 a70a056fc27524c65ea5ce4db43fe712cabb44cf9b171866abf805d7306d3b51, PR #511 head 05acdf96) was checked on 2026-09-30 against the installed guard it replaces (sha256 f9be81b240762dc58da874f135040d182ca9fb5e9056ab9b8a977dd909453244). Every check found no command the installed guard refuses that this guard allows: the acceptance oracle (65 cases, 0 mismatches), a side-by-side probe and a launcher option-value probe (0 loosened rows each), and a replay of 1,490 documented repository commands (0 newly blocked, 0 loosened, 0 reason changed). Run through a real hook process, four inputs from the third GPT-6 verification were refused with exit 2, one stderr line and no command echo in 0.06 to 0.14 s; the installed guard timed out at 10 s on three of them and took 4.03 s on the fourth. A read-only GPT-6 verification of this head (the fourth, after one repair round) found no command the installed guard refuses and this guard allows; its one blocking-labelled finding is a command that the installed guard also allows, recorded with a documentation note as residuals for the next guard change.
limitations: Local integration on one host plus read-only cross-family reviews, not a proof: the checks compare two text heuristics on finite corpora (the repository's test tables, fenced commands and generated mutations), and a review that finds nothing does not show that nothing exists.

Timings are wall-clock times on one host under its load at the time (a load average of about 7 to 20 during the day); the hook timeout of 10 s is this host's settings value, and a slower host has less margin.

The unit suite's one failure is by design: test_host_profile_copy_is_verbatim compares the installed host copy with the repository file, and the host copy stays the installed guard until the change is merged and reinstalled after the Gate A window closes.

Residuals carried to the next guard change (K4): `set 0 < /dev/null; set 0</dev/null` and nested forms are allowed by both guards because segment deduplication drops a descriptor-bearing duplicate; the module docstring and docs omit the conservative fallback for commands containing a \x01 byte.
evidence_class: local integration (the guard's acceptance oracle, probes, a documented-command replay, the unit suite and a real hook process on this host) plus two read-only cross-family reviews by GPT-6 (gpt-6-astra, effort max) through the OmniRoute gateway lane
